request.spec:
The order of the due steps changes: the late charge is now worked out on the rate figure alone,
or on the figure a statement bound, and the floor is applied last: a claim's live due is the
greater of the floor in force on its date and its figure plus its late charge. A statement now
binds the rate figure, not the floored one. Settled figures stay frozen; a correction is unchanged
(no floor, no charge).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The order of the due steps changes: the late charge is now worked out on the rate figure alone,
or on the figure a statement bound, and the floor is applied last: a claim's live due is the
greater of the floor in force on its date and its figure plus its late charge. A statement now
binds the rate figure, not the floored one. Settled figures stay frozen; a correction is unchanged
(no floor, no charge).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The new order is in place: a claim's late charge is now worked out on its rate figure (or the figure a statement bound), and the floor comes last. A claim's live due is the greater of the floor in force on its date and its figure plus its late charge. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

**Server** (`ClaimFigure.java`):
- The live figure no longer has the floor applied.
- A new helper, `floored`, works out the greater of the floor and figure-plus-charge. Corrections skip it, so they still get no floor and no charge, and a figure of n/a stays n/a.
- `withLate` returns a settled claim's frozen due unchanged; otherwise it applies the new order.
- **Settle and re-settle** fix the due with the same order, so the floor is applied after the late charge.
- **Statement** now binds each claim to its rate figure, without the floor or the late charge. Its due-total still includes both. A settled claim stays bound to its settled due, as before.
- Approving a pending claim, closing a period and the claim log already used the shared due calculation, so they follow the new order without their own changes.

**Front end** (`features/rates/rates.ts`): `claimDue` follows the same order, so the due on screen matches the server.

I also updated the comments that described the old order. The last one, in `Rollup.java`, was edited after the test run, but it changes a comment only.
